subject.title: improve(android): move Wear agent, session, and model pickers to Home

question: Should OpenClaw standardize Wear OS on the three-page Home/Chat, Voice, and Controls navigation, with Agent, Session, and Model selection exclusively on Home and model controls exposed through the new capability-gated companion RPCs?
rationale: The patch is not only an implementation repair: it removes two existing user-navigation surfaces and establishes a versioned inter-app capability contract whose UX and upgrade behavior require Android-owner intent.

options.title: Accept the Home-first contract
options.body: Approve the three-page Wear navigation and capability-gated model controls, with the existing mixed-version disablement behavior retained.

options.title: Retain dedicated context pages
options.body: Request a narrower UI revision that keeps Agent and Session pages while optionally adding Home shortcuts.

options.title: Pause for a separate Wear UX decision
options.body: Keep the branch open until the intended Watch information architecture and companion protocol policy are documented by the Android owner.

recommendation.title: Accept the Home-first contract
recommendation.body: Approve the three-page Wear navigation and capability-gated model controls, with the existing mixed-version disablement behavior retained.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is assigned to steipete and the branch's final Android/Wear hardening commits are authored by steipete.
